examples.label: Native Drawing creation through the shared revision and history owner
#2371 create a Null layer that adopts the selected layers; installed/UI acceptance remains pending

semantics: #2371 U11 / D36: the baseline layer kinds of the + menu (addNullLayer, addEffectLayer, addGuideLayer, addFolderLayer, src/js/timeline.js, and addEffectorLayer, src/js/effector-layer.js @1065e9d8) as ONE layer-create transaction: one revision and one history entry. kind null / effect / guide / folder / effector replaces the blank appended layer; `name` is chosen by the caller (the baseline names, Null N, Effet N, Guide N, Folder N, Effector N); `frame` is the playhead the pose of adopted layers is kept at. A Null (colour #ff2d78) and a Folder (colour #ffb020, expanded, empty effect stack) store `isNullLayer` and a `nullPos` anchor: `pos`, else the centre of the union of the bounds of `children` at `frame`, else the canvas centre. `children` (Null and Folder only) are the layers the user had selected: each is freed with its world pose kept (the Parent A rules, a keyed or expression-driven pose is refused unavailable) and parented to the new layer. A Guide (colour #00baff) stores `isGuideLayer`, `guidePos` (`pos`, else the canvas centre) and horizontal orientation, carries no content and is never rendered. An Effect layer starts with an empty effect stack. An Effector (colour #59d38a) needs `target`, a layer that hosts a duplicator (otherwise invalid_request, an unknown layer is not_found), stores the effector record with a radial falloff anchored at `pos` or the canvas centre and the seeded Offset Position (120, 0). `children` is refused for any other kind, `target` for any other kind than effector. No JS/Paper writer or fallback.
